notes.title: Prepare for Beta Weekend Five
notes.content:
[b]It’s finally here. The sand is stirring and the canyons are open. Prepare to venture into the unforgiving wastes of the Desert biome.[/b]

Beginning [b]22nd October 5pm PDT and ending 25th October 10pm PDT[/b], you will have just over three days to experience the raw beauty of our latest biome. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/0e74bc256ea8dee5149689c18ac520047ed223ff.png[/img]

[h2]MISSION BRIEFING: BLACKSAND[/h2]

Journey to the heart of Icarus’ uncharted desert biome, enduring arid conditions to gather survey data for the UDA. But beware – threats are unknown, and few have returned from this barren region.

With no trace of their whereabouts, we can only recommend you watch your step.

There have been rumours of a subterranean route to the desert, but Minos, the gas giant planet nearby, exerts such immense tidal forces, so these paths are anything but stable. You’re on your own out there.

[i]Certain stages of the mission will require a member of your team to be at minimum, level 25. It will also require certain recipes, so save some blueprint points.[/i]

[h2]New challenges[/h2]

The desert biome brings with it a whole new arid environment. Scorching heat is just one of the challenges – be on the lookout for wildlife that feels familiar but shouldn’t be trusted, weather that threatens even the most seasoned Prospector and geological limitations that may force you to plan your route. 

[b]Heat[/b] - Keep an eye on both the environmental temperature and your character’s. Thirst and heat can drain your stamina and you’ll need to rehydrate more often - so managing your water intake wisely can become critical. Wear appropriate armour and clothing that offers protection but doesn’t overheat you.

[b]Water[/b] - The Desert canyons have been carved by both water and Icarus’ powerful geotechnical forces. Remember where your water sources are before venturing into the sands – there’s nothing more painful and frustrating than slowly slipping into hallucinations as you dehydrate. 

[b]Cold[/b] - Remember, deserts are not always hot. At nighttime the temperature can plummet too.

[b]Flora[/b]- Plant life like fiber and wood will be harder to harvest in the arid Desert. You may want to stock up on ingredients for Pills such as the Anti-Poison Pill from the Kitchen Bench or Tonics from the Herbalism bench and before you leave the relative safety of the Forest. 

[b]Sandstorms and heatwaves[/b] - These aren’t storms for the faint of heart. There’s nothing more violent than the ground around you shifting, lifting and flying in your face. Don’t take a storm warning lightly, and make sure shelter is always available. 

[h2]New Wildlife[/h2]

While we won’t spoil all the new wildlife for you, here are a few of your new neighbours:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/fd65d91de226add397a866c54e803aa0b8092332.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/a45cf68107f1eed4d17aa802604168e1eb04887b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/247e6a664090145bca631e6585b037e289fb7326.png[/img]
[h2]Expanded Playing Area[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/e19047d984f99db53eb13eaac2e1c78b5ff8f774.png[/img]

Your playable area for Beta Weekend Five’s Blacksand mission includes the Forest starting area, then opens up the desert canyon to the North West. The Arctic is not accessible on this Prospect.

The Prospect from Beta Weekend 4 (Broken Arrow) is still available for you to choose and includes the Northern and South-Eastern Arctic zones, if you have unfinished business with polar bears.

Your level cap is at 30 again this weekend. 

[h2]Extra Day (Again!)[/h2]

Monday here in New Zealand is a national holiday, so we’re extending the Beta Weekend by one extra day again, so the team doesn’t have to put a new build out on their day off. This also gives you more time to complete the new Mission: Blacksand and last week's Mission: Broken Arrow. 

[h2]Reporting Bugs and Suggestions[/h2]

Please continue to report bugs, issues or suggestions during the Beta Weekend [url=https://icarus.featureupvote.com/][b]here[/b][/url]

Please search to see if your suggestion has already been posted before you submit, and upvote it if you find it!

We love it when you share your screenshots and clips with us. Be sure to tag us @surviveicarus on all socials, and [url=https://discord.gg/surviveicarus]join our Discord server[/url] to hang out with us and our community over this Beta Weekend! 

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

Below is a selection of key bug fixes and QOL improvements that we’ve actioned since the last Beta Weekend. This doesn’t reflect every change, but gives you an idea of where our effort has gone. Thanks - many of these bugs were reported by you on [url=https://icarus.featureupvote.com/]Feature Upvote[/url].

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the crafting bench could be fooled to think it had enough items to continue crafting
[*] Fixed a bug where the shelter trace stops functioning and does not resume until reload, causing players and deployables to incorrectly take exposure damage
[*] Fixed an issue with the ‘More for Less’ talent where the crafting recipe was incorrectly using resources and requiring double the intended amount
[*] Fixed a bug where dying and Respawning and then fitting Fur Armor leaves armor in first person
[*] Fixed a bug where the medicine pills weren’t providing any buffs due to the modifier removing itself immediately
[*] Fixed a rotation issue of Polar Bear eating a carcass animations (start and end)
[*] Fixed a bug where player appears in Out of Bounds Area when dropping in 011 for Broken Arrow mission
[*] Added a patch where the system will deny animal spawns for a period of time in the location one was killed
[*] Fixed an Error 024 by allowing the host to update the prospect heartbeat during the loading phase
[*] Fixed an Error 020 by fixing incorrect append type for wrapping associated member character slot data
[*] Adjusted the physics on the Cougar model to ragdoll more realistically
[*] Animals that are fleeing from you are no longer able to be hit with stealth attacks
[*] Fixed a bug where ammo was unloading into hotbar before main inventory, when there was still space for it
[*] Fixed a bug where arm armor wasn’t visible when in first person
[*] Fixed a bug where doors were being double-placed if  the existing door was open.
[*] Fixed an issue with solo talent tree being blocked by 'coming soon' nodes
[*] Removed debug plane placed on one tree stump (looked like a white target)
[*] Fixed a bug where punching was causing 0 damage, it will now cause 5. Remember though, Bears punch harder. 
[*] Fixed a bug where doors stopped rendering at certain distances
[/list]
[b]QOL improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Certain deployable items will now produce recipes concurrently instead of consecutively to follow a more logical experience and progression
[*] Added a Stat Modifier which modifies the held time to activate an item (i.e repair hammer)
[*] Added a variation on the wall piece to allow for double-windows
[*] Reworked the rain particle visual effects to provide a more realistic experience
[*] Added a bleeding modifier to injured animals to provide a more realistic tracking experience
[*] Split foliage quality and foliage distance into separate settings to help improve load speed and depth of field
[*] Added Incendiary Rifle Rounds for those who just want to watch the world burn
[*] Added Steel and Iron Repair Hammers
[*] We felt firearms were too strong, too early, so we rebalanced the tree to include a Bolt Action Rifle, with the Hunting Rifle moving to level 30. 	
[*] Set minimum charge required for Longbow, Recurve Bow and Compound Bow to 0.9 so arrows cant be launched at snail's pace
[*] Added messaging on solo talent tree to inform players that these talents are only activated when solo
[*] Doubled range of fire warming aura modifier for easier sleeping
[*] Added bench requirement tooltips on item repair context menu (i.e Longbow)
[*] Added variants keyprompt on deployables with variants (i.e Wall)
[*] Adjusted the min/max yield of the Rabbit so it produces less Fur
[/list]
[i]-Liam[/i]

[i][h2]Mission Achieved, Prospectors![/h2][/i]

Beta Weekend Four provided a challenge like never experienced before on Icarus, but you took it head on with confidence, creativity and a lot of courage. With the largest journey yet to complete on foot, changing biomes and fierce new predators, it took careful planning and resource management to successfully complete. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/846101a15595d3af2149ec4251441c6abf95421c.png[/img]

Mission Broken Arrow saw countless warheads recovered, bosses defeated and recovery missions completed. We also include several successful performance improvements (always more coming) and balance changes for this Beta Weekend, and put out a couple of hotfixes during the weekend that addressed some spawning issues and bugs. 

Make sure you keep sharing your clips and victory photos with us. We love seeing all of them, and it inspires us to keep daring to make something great for you all. 

[h2]You should all be Creative Directors[/h2]

Once again, we struggled to choose some favourites from all the clips you tagged us in over the weekend. Thank you to all our content creators, players and future gaming artists, you’ve outdone yourselves. Here’s a few we particularly enjoyed:

[url=https://clips.twitch.tv/BadFrozenClipzFutureMan-vXOClo4oAplY-5qJ]So close, yet so far - Jeff_the_maniac[/url]
[url=https://clips.twitch.tv/CarelessCalmSrirachaPastaThat-IKm1UkDakQZtoLIj]I'm going to make you into a hat! - SlothOcelot[/url]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/whoopwhoopgamin/clip/AbstemiousModernMouseDogFace-0k0gtAXWgqkxGWUA]WOAH WOAH WOAH - WhoopWhoopGamin[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nFk8CDWlhFY]Mammoth go Brrrr - Râ[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/d2ef4a6806578e0646de2d27ce7ee9fd1c91d19e.png[/img]

[h2]Getting the most out of Feature Upvote[/h2]

[url=https://icarus.featureupvote.com/]FeatureUpvote[/url] has become familiar to most of you, as our hub for players’ ideas, bugs, features and dreams. Our development team actively combs it for information. 

We’ve been working on optimising this over the last few weeks so it becomes an effective, efficient and easy hub for making sure the most popular community issues get recognition, and want to explain how you can make sure your feedback is heard. 

[i][h3]1 - Before submitting a ticket, do a quick search that a similar ticket doesn’t already exist[/h3][/i]
Often, your great idea or bug has already been reported, even if in slightly different words. Before you submit a new ticket, search for some keywords to see if someone else has said something similar, and add to it as a comment, along with upvoting it, so we know it's important. Submitting a duplicate ticket might result in 20 tickets getting created for an issue rather than one ticket with 20 votes, which is more likely to be prioritized.

[i][h3]2 - Make sure you’re super clear and detailed in your explanations[/h3][/i]
We’re combing through thousands of tickets a weekend, so providing good, crisp and clear information is critical if we’re going to be able to take your feedback. Where, when and how does the issue occur? What steps could we take to reproduce the bug ourselves? If relevant, what graphics card and drivers do you have?

[i][h3]3 - Keep it constructive, we’re all building this game together[/h3][/i]
We know bugs and imbalances are frustrating, but that’s why we do these Beta Weekends! When submitting your tickets or comments, make sure to breathe, think through your feedback, and provide it in a constructive way. Getting upset just makes it trickier for us to decipher what you mean which leads to us not being able to include your feedback in our sprints. 

We’ve loved so many of the ideas, suggestions and thoughts you’ve offered over the last four weeks. Let's make the next three  even better by using feature upvote to its full potential!

notes.title: Prepare for Beta Weekend #4
notes.content:
It begins on Friday 8th October at 5pm PDT and lasts an extra day until Monday 11th 10pm PDT. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149460/view/2903123926607532621]As we posted yesterday,[/url] we’re adding an extra Beta Weekend. This means the Desert biome will be unlocked in two weeks’ time, and the other Beta Weekends are all pushed back two weeks too. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/fb1d7e69c2f7dae0cef962e5dae50a7af69881f0.png[/img]

[b][h2]MISSION BRIEFING: BROKEN ARROW[/h2][/b]
[h3]RECOVER ENZYME WARHEADS FROM THREE DOWNED TERRAFORMING SATELLITES.[/h3]

[b]BACKGROUND:[/b]

When terraforming failed, the UDA tried to put the political and environmental catastrophe behind them. Mothballing the Inaris-designed atmospheric processing satellites, Icarus was supposed to be forgotten. A decade on, these orbital bio-factories are de-orbiting. The UDA wants no more scandals. 

[b]MISSION:[/b]

Recover the enzyme 'warheads' from three crashed Inaris satellites, before anyone else.

[b]TERMS:[/b]

Geo-data in this region is unavailable, so your team will be inserted at a known drop point. At least two of the satellites impacted in the arctic. Expect a demanding journey, heavy weather, sub-zero temperatures, and fierce wildlife.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/11135dbb5a393a4b2b323ebf6a3c39802a601436.png[/img]

For more background on Icarus’ terraforming and the UDA check out the [url=https://surviveicarus.com/lore/]History of Icarus[/url] on our website. This will be expanded as more of Icarus’ lore is unveiled over time.

[h2]An extra day on Monday[/h2]

Since this three-part Mission spans the Forest biome, the northern Arctic biome as well as the newly-unlocked southern Arctic region, we’re going to give you an extra 24 hours to complete the Mission. That’s right, this Beta Weekend will continue until Monday evening (PDT).

[h2]New wildlife detected[/h2]

The satellites’ crash sites have drawn the attention of some of Icarus' most fearsome wildlife. The cause of their heightened interest and aggression remains unclear, but research suggests a potential connection to the terraforming technology. Group 15 has refused to release any further information at this stage.

The Arctic poses familiar threats, with reports of another Mammoth and the largest Polar Bear yet seen roaming the ice, but a new predator has been reported deep in the forest. Without further data available, we can only suggest you tread with caution and keep your eyes focused on the undergrowth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/e23849e9dc9a120e6d538c8f0d3d3cd7ee10186f.png[/img]

[h2]An Expanded Playable Area[/h2]

This Beta Weekend another Arctic zone has opened up - in the South-East of the map. You may have come across the entrance to it when exploring previously (and got a warning if you ventured in).
 
While the in-game map still lacks terrain data, the locations of the three satellites have been marked. One is in the Central Arctic, one in the Forest valleys and one in the new Southern Arctic region. 

Here’s the area you can explore this weekend:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/8eeee0ef21a6db26cba5b5152456a0af824bee9b.png[/img]

[h2]Tech Tree and Talents Reset[/h2]

Your characters have all been returned to the Orbital Station ready for a new Prospect.

We’ve rebalanced and made several changes to the Talent Tree and the Planetary Tech Tree - so have reset all your points for you to spend again. 

Overall we have reduced the number of Blueprints awarded with each level. We know many of you have strong opinions about whether there are too many or too few unlocks at each level, so we’ll be paying close attention to how you progress this weekend. Solo players are encouraged to check out the Solo Talent Tree, and give us feedback on FeatureUpvote.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/26b0fb5edcfb3f90fa8ce17cb18a94da4a974fcb.png[/img]

[h2]More Languages[/h2]

Icarus will be available [b]at launch[/b] in English, German, French, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Latin American Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Mandarin, Japanese and Korean!
 
Beta Weekend 4 will include the first versions of our translations for some of these languages. These are all very much in development and will include a lot of missing text, typos and gaps, but it gives us a chance to see how they work when deployed to you, the players. We know there will be gaps, and are not looking for feedback on translation errors on FeatureUpvote just yet.

You change languages in the Settings menu.

We know people would like even more languages and after our launch we may introduce tools for the community to contribute their own translations.

[h2]Reporting Bugs and Suggestions[/h2]

[url=https://icarus.featureupvote.com/]Please continue to report bugs, issues or suggestions during the Beta Weekend here.[/url]
Please check to see if your suggestion has already been posted before you submit it, and upvote it if you find it!

We love it when you share your screenshots and clips with us. Be sure to tag us @surviveicarus on all socials, and join our Discord server to hang out with us and our community this Beta Weekend! 

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

Check our Steam Forums for detailed Patch Notes and any Known Issues when the weekend begins.

[b]Notable Quality of Life changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a requirement for prospectors to be near a source of warmth to be able to sleep
[*] The Rain Reservoir now has slots for ice and containers
[*] Rebalanced recipes for benches, concrete buildables, weapons/tools and cabinets to now require iron nails and steel screws, and adjusted the ingot requirements accordingly
[*] Added a blueprint to the armor bench allowing you to turn leather into rope
[*] Now only the players dropship will show on the minimap, rather than all prospectors’
[/list]
[b]Some of the key fixes and improvements this weekend are:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced animal respawning
[*] Fixed a bug where other languages would not load when the player switched to them in the settings
[*] Fixed a bug where any stack that was 50%+ of the crafting requirements for a recipe was consumed and considered enough to execute the craft
[*] Fixed a bug where some players couldn’t see a deployed fireplace
[*] Fixed a bug where concrete buildables had a distorted visual appearance due to corrupted LODs
[*] Fixed a bug where ctrl+clicking an item could lead to it being ‘lost’ rather than shifting inventories
[*] Fixed a bug where the shovel wasn’t reducing in durability as it was used to collect ice
[*] Fixed an issue with the polar bear and mammoth movement where they were interacting with the ground incorrectly
[*] Fixed a visual issue where the snow on a roof didn’t have the effects of snow in the terrain
[*] Fixed a visual issue where the fireplace didn’t have flame particles
[*] Fixed a bug where the dehumidifier could only be deployed through the hotbar and not the inventory
[*] Fixed a bug where there was no stamina penalty for using a axe, knife or pickaxe as a client on someone else's prospect
[*] Fixed a visual error where some trapdoors and windows weren’t ‘flush’ with their wall/floor piece

notes.title: Changes to our Beta Weekends Schedule and Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/3ee2a5b2f168f8e289ba0545e3aa8ebee390a401.png[/img]

[h2]On Icarus always be prepared for change, Prospector.
[/h2]
Our first three Beta Weekends have absolutely exceeded our expectations. Nearly 200,000 people have played, many returning every Beta Weekend, for an average of 8 hours each. Many of you have sunk more than 20 hours into Icarus so far. 

You, the players, have given us more insight, feedback, love and support than we could have ever imagined. We’ve aimed to reciprocate this in our work on the game, making an array of updates and changes to ensure each weekend is an improvement on the last. We’re feeling confident about our progress towards Icarus’ 1.0 launch.

[i][b]With all these new insights, we have made a big decision that impacts the upcoming Beta Weekend (Oct 9th - 11th) and our eventual launch date that we want to explain below.[/b][/i]

The key changes are:
[list]
[*] A new three-part Mission this Beta Weekend (9-11 October)
[*] An extra 24 hours on Monday for this Beta Weekend
[*] Desert Beta Weekend moved to 23-24 October
[*] All Beta Weekends rescheduled by two weeks
[*] Icarus’ scheduled launch date is now [b]4 December[/b] - [i]but is still subject to change[/i]
[/list]
[h2]Changes to our Beta Weekends Schedule[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/97aa2ba6293bb4f92dd7203c0b2c2010c3ca8743.png[/img]

We’re adding an extra Beta Weekend. This weekend (9-11 October) we’re going to send you on a three-part Mission to recover crashed bio-satellites and learn more about Icarus’ terraforming, rather than dispatching you to the Desert. 

This epic three-part Mission spans the Forest biome, the northern Arctic biome as well as the newly-unlocked southern Arctic region, so [b]we’re giving you an extra 24 hours to complete the Mission[/b]. That’s right, this Beta Weekend will continue until Monday evening (PDT).

This means the Desert biome will be unlocked in two weeks’ time, and the other Beta Weekends are also pushed back by two weeks. This lets us include more improvements to the Desert biome, based on the environmental tech art optimization lessons we learnt for the Arctic Beta Weekend. It’s a great example of how the focused Beta Weekends format lets us learn from one weekend and apply it to another.

Players loved the ‘hunt the Mammoth’ mission from the Arctic Beta Weekend, so we’re giving you more of it. Faction Missions, set by the various corporations and organizations operating on Icarus, with specific goals and rewards, are one type of Prospect that really showcases Icarus’ session-based gameplay. They provide a goal and purpose on top of our core survival experience.

[i]We’ll share more details about the Mission Beta Weekend #4 with you tomorrow.[/i]

Expect more additions to the schedule in future. In the coming weeks we’ll announce details of the next Mission Beta Weekend (6-7 November) as well as plans and prizes for the Community Beta Weekend (20-21 November).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/5316910180fc5561bd30712f44a1d9805d293954.png[/img]

[h2]What this means for our 1.0 launch[/h2]

If you’ve done the math, you’ll know this pushes out our launch date from the date on our Steam Store page of November 20th, and we wanted to talk a bit about that here. 

We’ve always maintained that we’d make any changes to our timeline necessary in order to deliver you a world-class game that we’re proud of. We have chosen to act on that promise here. 

[b]This means the new projected launch date is 4th December - although this could still change.
[/b]
(This date may take a few days to update on our Steam Store page)

While we’re confident in our timeline, you can be the judge. There are two more months of Beta Weekends until then for you to measure our progress. Remember, during the Beta Weekends you can refund Icarus at any time. Once we launch, Steam’s usual two-hours refund policy applies.

Giving us this extra window of time allows us more room to polish all the new features and content we’ve been adding over the last few weekends. On top of this, an unexpected covid-19 lockdown here in New Zealand has put extra stress on our team and resources, and taking care of everyone's well being comes first for us. This has meant readjusting timelines, capacity and workloads. 

And to cap it all off November 20th is a big day in gaming with the arrival of Battlefield 2042! While this title isn’t a direct competitor for our audience, it will take up a lot of airtime in the gaming world, so moving our launch outside this window is the best idea for us (and the players ultimately). 

Delays are a common practice in gaming, as they are with any creative media. While we never take them lightly, they’re a decision we will confidently make in the interest of the game, the players and the team. The beauty of RocketWerkz self-publishing is that this decision is our own, and we will strive to communicate this to you at the earliest possible convenience. 

Remember, there are some key features we are purposefully holding until our 1.0 launch. These include Exotics Missions, Outposts and the Workshop tech-tree in the orbital station. While some of you have already surpassed 20 hours in-game (wow!), there is so much content we’re yet to introduce. 

[h2]How the Beta is Going[/h2]

[previewyoutube=UWCvdCaQ9Bs;full][/previewyoutube]

Check out our latest Making of Icarus video to hear our views on how we think the Beta is going.

As we said earlier, our expectations for player numbers and feedback have been exceeded. The every-two-weekends format has worked really well for gathering player feedback and for our team. These regular updates are something we intend to continue post launch too. Icarus, both the planet and the game, will be a living and ever-evolving world.

[i]- Liam[/i]

notes.title: Prepare for Beta Weekend #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/35778f254a413fbebafefae7881fa424656ac84e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Welcome back Prospectors![/h1]

Our next Beta Weekend begins on [b]Friday 24th September at 5pm PDT[/b] where you’ll finally get a taste of the Arctic!

The arctic has been the most anticipated biome from our community. It’s home to a Mammoth, Polar Bears, Wolves, its own weather events like blizzards, and ice caves. Yes, that’s right! Ice caves!

As portrayed in our community Twitch streams with Dean and Lorii - simply getting to the arctic and surviving there is no easy feat. So, that’s why we’re going to give you a little guidance on how to get a head start on your prospects this weekend. We’ll also cover exciting quality of life updates, and of course some patch notes to keep you up to speed with the current state of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/d2ef4a6806578e0646de2d27ce7ee9fd1c91d19e.png[/img] [i]Image by Discord member: Cav3dust[/i]

[h2]Don’t just run there, prepare![/h2]
You’ve landed in your drop ship and the door opens into the forest biome. You step outside and look for the closest point of entry to the arctic. You’re so excited and start running there...wait wait wait, hold on prospector -- there are a few things you should do first!

[olist]
[*][b]Collect resources and get crafting.[/b]
Just like previous Beta Weekends, you will be presented with the same challenges as soon as you set foot on Icarus. Do what you’ve done best and chop down trees, hunt, build a cabin and craft necessities such as weapons and fur armour to prepare for your expedition into the cold.

[*][b]Determine your prospector’s life-threatening needs.[/b]
While the forest biome is sufficient with freshwater lakes and oxite, the arctic is not. Craft and fill a water skin and oxygen bladder so you can top up when needed. While you’re in the arctic you can find ice (scattered across the snowy ground) and melt them down into water by using a campfire, which will subsequently fill your water skin. Having an ample amount of food to satiate your hunger until your first arctic hunt would also be smart.

[*][b]Bring supplemental resources with you.[/b]
Once you’re in the thick of the arctic, having the ability to build a cabin for shelter midway to your final destination could save your life. Carry extra wood, ore, refined metals and any other crafting benches or tables that can fit into your inventory without sacrificing your weight or other important items. If you’re playing in a group, try dispersing these items among your team. In the case that you fall short of resources, caves make great safe havens and host an array of ore.
[/olist]
[h2]Map - Expanded Playable Area[/h2]
Each Beta Weekend we open up the Icarus map more than the previous! Since we are unlocking a completely new biome, there is a far wider area to explore and play. Yellow signifies the Arctic biome, and blue being the Forest where you have been before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/9cfac8d655dc58fe8f97ed66d17e8cf86e57748f.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]All prospects have been cleared
[*]Characters who were on drops have been returned to the station ready to head to a new prospect with their current talent and skill unlocks intact
[*]Character level cap remains the same at Level 25
[*]Buildings constructed on cliff-faces will no longer destroy themselves when players reload into the prospect
[*]Animals will no longer try to path through dropships
[*]When placing a full Oxygen Tank into a hotbar slot, it will now fill the player’s oxygen to 100%
[*]Left clicking the Oxygen Tank in the hotbar now consumes oxygen
[*]Lightning can no longer destroy items inside caves
[*]Arrows will no longer duplicate when they are recovered from skinned corpses
[*]Players can no longer be struck by lightning while inside a house
[*]Logged out players no longer show as a dead prospector
[*]Logged out players no longer show as a dead marker on the map
[*]Players no longer fall through the world when reloading their prospect into a cave
[*]Animals can no longer attempt to path through cave voxel coverings
[*]Animal corpses now despawn after 10 minutes
[*]Animal corpses no longer respawn when the player reloads into the prospect
[*]Repaired building pieces (floor, wall, beam etc) can now also stack with newly crafted building pieces inside the player’s inventory
[*]Rifle rounds now break on hit
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Modular Kitchens
[*]Functional Curtains
[/list]
We also deployed quality of life adjustments among our developers! We enforced a relative stand-down to those who worked longer hours over Beta Weekend Two. If it wasn’t for their hard work, the mass of hotfixes and updates we pushed through would not have been possible! As a side, this means that the amount of bug fixing between Beta Weekends was limited. But we are more than happy with the results we have achieved, and with a well rested team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/e479792672b0fdf21dafdce6888ea92b1d47d6f1.png[/img] [i]Image by Discord member: kininja[/i]

[h2]Reporting Bugs and Suggestions[/h2]
We’re consistently amazed at how well our community is utilizing the platform we’ve chosen to receive feedback. We’re improving processes on our end so we can clearly communicate with you the status of each ticket, and how we prioritize them to our team. This is just a big ol’ THANK YOU for helping make Icarus the best it can be.

[b]Please continue to report bugs and any other issues or suggestions during Beta Weekend #3 here: [url=https://icarus.featureupvote.com/]https://icarus.featureupvote.com/[/url][/b]

[i][h3]See you in the Arctic![/h3][/i]
We're looking forward to your Icarus gameplay, screenshots and your tales of journeying through the Arctic! Be sure to tag us [b]@surviveicarus[/b] on all socials, and join our Discord server to hang out with us and our community this Beta Weekend! Click [url=https://discord.gg/surviveicarus/]here[/url]

[i]- Lorii[/i]

notes.title: Beta Weekend 2 Balance Hotfix v0.5.0.76969
notes.content:
Beta Weekend Two is continuing to prove popular! To keep the momentum of the Beta Weekend going strong we have a bunch more improvements we wanted to add so you can have the best experience possible this weekend. 

It is also a good chance for us to show you, through our actions, that we want this project to be about quick and fast iteration. We aim to listen to the community and implement feedback and ideas that we feel fit with the game quickly where possible.

[h2]Bodies will now drop items in a bundle[/h2]
This allows you to recover your items when you die, if you reach the bundle before it despawns. This has been a very popular feature request. We were planning on adding it for Beta Weekend 3 (BW3), but we have decided to add it right now for this Beta Weekend. When you respawn, if you return to the place you died there will be a bundle you can pick up with your previous inventory.

[h2]Living in Caves[/h2]
We have added a Dehumidifier that clears the underground cave buff and runs on Charcoal. We have also added this ability to the Antiobiotics (which used to be called Antiseptics). This will help if you want to live underground.

[h2]Recovering Arrows/Spears/Blades[/h2]
This is another highly-requested feature. Now when you skin an animal, the attached arrows, knives, and spears will be added to the animal inventory. This means you can recover these from the body easily, and they don't fall through the world or get lost.

[h2]Detailed Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*]The central server has been under heavy load. We have made a few tweaks to streamline the process and - in particular - give you more feedback when the game is doing something so that you know to wait. 
[*]Added Aluminum Ingots to be made on the Concrete Furnace
[*]Increased the time needed to smelt Aluminum Ingots to be on par with Steel
[*]Added the Anti-Underground buff to Antibiotics
[*]Moved the Skinning Bench talent up in the talent tree and confirmed the unlock and craft flow
[*]Added Dehumidifier asset on Tier 3. It uses the same recipe as the Metal Oxite Dissolver currently
[*]Added an overflow container which is spawned at player location when a player choses to revive themselves ([url=https://icarus.featureupvote.com/suggestions/204950/suggestion-solo-play-death-penalty-too-great]request[/url])
[*]Fixed stealth damage indicator showing '0x damage' for clients
[*]Fixed Resolution Settings displaying incorrectly as default values after setting, confusing people to think it has not changed
[*]Added stealth attacks now only occur when crouched, added required stat by default and made the related talent 'Coming Soon'. Stealth attacks are no longer determined by ballistic actor, but on damage taken on the NPC. Aggressive motivation being triggered now guarantees no stealth, previously it would be partial stealth if the NPC didn't have a cautious motivation (such as the wolf)
[*]Adding a Dehumidifier that can be placed in caves to prevent the debuff. It provides an aura which provides players a buff which holds off the underground debuff, powered by charcoal
[*]Added Antiseptics are now called Antibiotics and last 10 minutes, they also clear the underground debuff
[*]Adding processor recipes for Dehumidifier and adding to talent tree
[*]Modifier Aluminum Ingot crafting time to be on par with Steel Ingots
[*]Added Aluminum to Concrete Furnace
[*]Added when players pick up an animal, any attached projectiles are put in the player's inventory
[*]Added when a player skins an animal, any attached projectiles are placed into the animal's inventory ([url=https://icarus.featureupvote.com/suggestions/205014/suggestion-arrow-recovery-from-animals]request[/url])
[*]Fixing binding for stealth UI that could never be initialized depending on if the player character was created when the UI beings initialization. This was the bug where you would show as not being stealth.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Weekend 2 Balance Hotfix v0.5.0.76943
notes.content:
Thank you for your fantastic feedback on Beta Weekend Two so far! We've been watching your streams and reading your chats on Discord and social media with great interest, and the occasional laugh.
  
This hotfix has some changes that will greatly improve the gameplay balance. We felt these were safe to make, and also important enough for you to play so we can confirm our approach before we refine Beta Weekend 3 content.
[quote]Normally, we won't do hotfixes during the weekend to try and keep the experience stable. Additionally, we like to let the team have a well earned rest after a busy few weeks. However, we want to make a few balance changes so we can verify our broader approach to experience and animals - before we start opening up other areas.[/quote]
[h2]Try out the Beta Weekend risk free right now![/h2]
Want to try these out? Pre-order Icarus to get access to the Beta Weekend right now. You can play the beta as long as you like and refund at any time before launch no matter how much you play.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149460/ICARUS/

[h2]Experience from Crafting Increased Dramatically[/h2]
We made a lot of changes to the experience balance from Beta Weekend 1 already, but one area missing was the experience from crafting things. As an example, crafting a wall was only giving you experience of half that of recovering a bush. What the object is made of is a big determiner of how much experience you got - but we hadn't balanced it since our last big changes.

This will dramatically affect the pacing of the game. Previous to this update, crafting gave you effectively no experience. Now, crafting things will give you plenty of experience and will speed up your progress in the game. 

[h2]Player Respawning[/h2]
In a future Beta Weekend we will be leaving your gear where you die for a period of time. This was considered too risky to include in a hotfix. We have also fixed an exploit where you had full survival stats when you respawn, this is no longer the case. 

[h2]Weapon Damage Rebalance[/h2]
Significant changes have been made to weapon balance, specifically:
[list][*] Throwing spears will cause significantly more damage (x2 to x4 more, depending on spear type)
[*] Projectile damage for arrows increased
[*] Arrows now cause much more critical hit damage (10-25% depending on type)
[*] Rifle Round causes much more damage
[*] Rifle Round now causes dramatically more critical hit damage.
[/list] 
[h2]Predator Perception Nerfed[/h2]
[list][*] Wolf has perception reduced slightly, and its lost sight radius reduced.
[*] Bear has perception reduced slightly, lost sight radius reduced, and hearing reduced dramatically.
[/list] 
[h2]Miscellaneous Changes[/h2]
[list][*]There was a small section in the BW3 playing area, that was incorrectly set to the be the arctic biome - causing blizzards and storms that were killing people. This has been fixed.
[*]Reduce all Aluminum recipe costs by factor of five
[*]Increase Coal yield again, another 20%
[*]Reduced XP from Oxite and Sulphur
[*]Fixed Posion Arrow was not doing damage or slowdown over time
[/list]

notes.title: ICARUS Beta Weekend Two Live NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/8c30024a4cd29bb476750f3f4b6d2b26481f12c2.png[/img]

[h3][b]Beta Weekend 1 was a huge success![/b][/h3]

Welcome back, Prospectors.
 
We topped Steam’s Global Top Sellers chart for our first Beta Weekend, which blew us away for a two-day Beta. Thank you to everyone who pre-ordered, joined us and gave feedback!

[h1]Message from Rocket (Gamerunner)[/h1]
[quote=rocket2guns]For us Beta Weekend 1 (BW1) was primarily about testing the core of the game, both in a gameplay mechanics sense as well as architecturally. Our servers held up, and the game held up pretty well too. The base survival mechanics were generally solid, but it was clear we needed to develop more on the exploration and survival aspects of the game, even beyond our original schedule. So we did. One of the key lessons I have from past projects is the importance of being able to iterate very quickly. This allows us to adapt the game every Beta Weekend without taking on huge amounts of technical risk.

In Beta Weekend 2 you will see a huge focus on increasing exploration, testing the limits of pacing, as well as slowly opening up more content of the game for us to balance and develop further. We've also started to hints how we will approach the lore.

We'll be watching your videos, livestreams, and VODs and, as always, reading and replying to your posts on the forums and Discord.

[i]Dean Hall
Gamerunner[/i]
[/quote]
[h1]What’s new in Beta Weekend 2[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/9f5e5545abc9a976f70088273b92d4c30f895f02.png[/img]

The key addition this Beta Weekend is storms and extreme weather events. Expect severe winds, flash storms and thunderstorms that can damage your structures and lightning strikes that could even spark forest fires. Don't worry, you'll receive a warning as they approach to give you time to find or build shelter and to unlock your fire whacker, repair hammer or stronger building tiers.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149460/view/3001069789774328218]Read our Weather System blog for more details on what to expect.[/url]

There's so much more than just storms. We've also added four times more playable area to explore, caves full of valuable metals, more building options, varied animal danger levels and more survival challenges like infections and fractures.

[h2]Surprise, we dropped 24 hours early![/h2]

We think there are so many new gameplay systems in this Beta Weekend that we’re giving you an extra 24 hours to play. We turned on the servers a whole day earlier at 5pm Thursday instead of 5pm Friday PDT. 

That's right, Icarus is LIVE NOW. 

There is no change to the end time. The Beta Weekend will continue until 10pm Sunday PDT. We can’t promise that we'll launch early for future Beta Weekends, though.

[h2]A Character Wipe[/h2]
Unfortunately your characters and prospects from Beta Weekend 1 have been wiped. While we prefer not to do this, we had to this time due to the extensive gameplay changes and some big backend improvements. You'll find the levelling up progression much different this time around.

[h2]A 4x larger map[/h2]

Beta Weekend 2 comes with a big increase to the playable area, as shown in orange in the map below. With 4x as much space to explore, expect to find more caves, lakes, waterfalls and cliffs as well as a sneak-peak into edges of the arctic and desert biomes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/31cec9be7f2f64e4ae64d9f16abfb83d89aaeeb1.png[/img]

Oh, but also, something has happened to your in-game map... It’s temporarily unavailable for this Beta Weekend. The above map is all the info you’ve got to go on - best of luck!

[h2]Caves and Mining[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/3299f37a73365ad549ecefea4ea6bbe2369cd06c.png[/img]
[i]Credit: ArmyVet[/i]

One of the larger balance changes affects metal ores and caves. While in the first Beta Weekend metal ores were abundant and easy to find, we’ve adjusted their availability in Beta Weekend 2. Almost all valuable metal ores, such as gold, copper, aluminum, are now found exclusively in caves, of which there are more than 30 scattered around this Weekend’s map. This means you'll need to explore deeper into the wilderness as you progress through the planetary tech tree. 

[h2]More building options and tiers[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/43b1d611e53a24afb2becc7cd6fc1b4b0304c326.png[/img]

We were impressed with the amazing structures players posted on social media and Twitch last Weekend, and we’ve listened to your requests for even more building pieces.
 
Added to the mix are roof corner pieces, half walls, inverted corner pieces, double doors and the option to choose which side of the frame a door hinge will be on by moving your mouse to either side when placing. This Beta Weekend also unlocks two whole new building tiers, Aluminum and Concrete. We’re excited to see what you create with all the new options available to you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/24bdb44cb8e619a6a875d0b0d59abe0bcd65c239.png[/img]

[h2]More survival mechanics[/h2]

Beta Weekend 2 also scales up the survival challenges and solutions with new mechanics, modifiers and debuffs that require careful planning and quick responses. Look out for infected wounds, deep wounds, fractures from fall damage, food poisoning as well as new bandages and poultices to provide relief.

[h2]Scaling animal strength[/h2]

While there were many brilliant animal encounters in Beta Weekend 1, we’ve expanded their complexity and variety as we introduce animal scaling. As you explore further into the wilderness the more aggressive, dangerous, powerful and populated animals will become. Animals will also scale as you level, so be prepared to be challenged at all times. 

[h2]Basic Firearms[/h2]

Your weapons are due for an upgrade. Beta Weekend 2 unlocks two highly-requested firearms, the Shotgun and the Hunting Rifle. We’re keen to hear your experiences with these items and look forward to all the amazing clips you’re going to capture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/e50a51c1a7bde035b200c9e2a88f7e18e0370e2d.png[/img]
[i]Credit: StixxAus[/i]

[h2]Graphics compatibility[/h2]

While we’ve made many graphics optimizations for this weekend and there will be many more for our full launch, we also learned a lot about how Icarus runs on different people’s graphics cards. We’ve built Icarus to take advantage of many of the latest graphics rendering techniques - so updating your PC to the latest graphics drivers and using DirectX12 will improve performance for many users, including those with AMD cards.

[h2]Last chance to win![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/723837c8eeeab8908245dd0b4d19647b997901e5.jpg[/img]

Our gleam.io competition to win some sweet Logitech G peripherals and Steam Wallet funds closes at the end of this Beta Weekend. [url=https://gleam.io/mtEYx/the-icarus-beta-weekends-giveaway-1]Enter here![/url] 

[h2]Give us your feedback. [/h2]

You can submit suggestions and bugs and upvote other people’s feedback using [url=https://icarus.featureupvote.com/]Feature Upvote[/url]. 

If you want to read a more detailed breakdown of our patch notes, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1149460/discussions/0/3037104113121957799/]you can find these here in the Steam Forums[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149460/ICARUS/

notes.title: How Our Beta Weekends Work
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/2e6c8a16ad3ced7731b93c2f3d3b0bebd04bc05e.png[/img]

[h2]So you’ve pre-ordered Icarus? You can try our Beta Weekends[/h2]

Everyone who has pre-ordered Icarus on Steam will gain access to our Beta Weekends, which happen every second weekend. In between these weekends you won't be able to access the game. To play, look for the [i]Icarus Beta[/i] app in your Steam Library (this is different to the [i]Icarus[/i] app which will unlock for our full launch).

[h2]When are the Beta Weekends?[/h2]

They're every two weekends and unlock new content each time:
[list]
[*] 28-29 August - Forest
[*] 11-12 September - Storms
[*] 25-26 September - Arctic
[*] 9-10 October - Mission (NEW)
[*] 23-24 October - Desert
[*] 6 - 7 November - Missions
[*] 20-21 November - Community
[/list]

We’ve structured our Beta Weekends to add more content each time so you can give us clear feedback on each new feature. Once each Beta Weekend is over, we listen to community feedback and do our best to work on any critical fixes before the next Beta Weekend or before our full launch!

For more detail on the content we've planned, see our previous Steam post [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149460/view/3002196778025887893]here[/url].

Some features will be added at our full launch, after our beta period has finished. Exotic Matter, the mysterious elements that caused Icarus’ terraforming to fail, won't be available for you to mine until launch but when you do they'll earn valuable items in the orbital workshop. Outposts, ideal for uninterrupted base building, will also only be available to play after launch.

[h2]What time do they start?[/h2]

[h4][u]Pacific Daylight Time (PDT)[/u] 5pm Friday through to 10pm Sunday[/h4]
[h4][u]Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)[/u] 12am Saturday through to 5am Monday[/h4]
[h4][u]New Zealand Time (NZT)[/u] 12noon Saturday through to 5pm Monday[/h4]

To include as many time zones as possible they last for a bit longer than 48 hours. 

If you try to play Icarus outside these times, you’ll see a message explaining that you cannot connect to our servers - in which case, wait and come back for the next scheduled Beta Weekend.

For real-time updates and when you can play, please follow our Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/surviveicarus]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/d2e1348d4519f17648e30418f06986084d230df4.png[/img]

[h2]Prospects[/h2]

The prospects you can play will last for the duration of each Beta Weekend.

If you are successful in your prospects and use your dropship to head back to the orbital station, your character's progress will be kept across each Beta Weekend. This includes your tech and talent tree unlocks, but does not include your planetary inventory. Surviving is easier said than done, so be careful! However, there [i]might[/i] be some character wipes during the beta or before launch. Remember though, everyone who has pre-ordered Icarus will receive at 10% XP boost for the launch week so your progress will be faster.

If your character permanently dies, cannot be revived, or you decide to leave your prospect entirely at any point -- you can begin another, fresh prospect from the orbital station.

If you want to quit the game mid-way through a prospect, but wish to resume the same prospect later, you can! Just access the in-game menu and quit. When you launch Icarus again, pick that same character and you will be taken back to that prospect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/47b6c02130bdf08801a06c4c04766c8d82fce946.png[/img]

[h2]Characters[/h2]

There are three character slots available for you to fill! The character level cap and Tech Tree tiers will gradually increase throughout the Beta period.

We’re granting you the opportunity to play around with different talents across different characters during our Beta Weekends! Depending on how you wish to experience Icarus, we would recommend that you spend the first weekend levelling up one character first so you can get into a good rhythm and up your chances of survival.

You cannot share the same Prospect between your three characters. Only one can play a prospect at a time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/5955e01cdbf9b967331929bb72dd62b08fd42b3f.png[/img]

[h2]Teaming up with other Prospectors[/h2]

While there are benefits to playing Icarus alone - like becoming a well-rounded and independent prospector - you can also play with your friends!                    

Currently you can add prospectors to your game session via Steam’s Friend List interface. Please bear (no pun intended!) with us as we look into more avenues surrounding this.

Join our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/surviveicarus]here[/url] and find folks to play with in our #LFG (looking for a group) channel. Our community is thriving with people eager to get stuck-in, and those who wish to help others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/79b040be0bb9a63bd8c121ba2d6638cc938ed5e5.png[/img]

[h2]Follow us for regular updates[/h2]

We will be communicating updates in real-time to make announcements regarding:

[list]
[*]When each Beta Weekend goes live
[*]Server status information
[*]Known issues and solutions
[*]Shared media from content creators
[*]When each Beta Weekend ends
[/list]
+ more via our social channels
[url=https://discord.gg/surviveicarus]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/surviveicarus]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://facebook.com/surviveicarus]Facebook[/url]

Unless there are any game-breaking issues, we plan to resolve any bugs throughout the week outside of Beta Weekend activity.

[h2]How to report problems and provide us with your Beta Weekend feedback[/h2]

Icarus is ready for its players! We need your fresh set of eyes to test and play the game. We’re committed to listening to our community so we can develop Icarus to ensure the best possible experience for you on launch day.

[b]Please report bugs and other issues at[/b] [url=https://icarus.featureupvote.com]https://icarus.featureupvote.com[/url]

Our devs read these tickets and you can see tags with more detail around its state and progress. Feature Upvote is user-friendly and easy to use without having to log in or make an account.

We have channels within our Discord server where you can discuss Icarus and any issues with other players, but please note we will be monitoring the Feature Upvote page for official reports.

[h2]Streaming and VOD content is encouraged![/h2]

Whether you are a seasoned or newcoming content creator, we would love for you to show your Icarus gameplay to the world. Keep in mind that Icarus is in Beta, and we are proactively working to squash all bugs and performance issues that arise and that are reported to us.

Our Community Manager Lorii and other developers will be keenly dipping in and out of your channels across Twitch, YouTube and Facebook, saying hello and enjoying your gameplay! We may be streaming Icarus on our accounts too!

Content creators can apply for a beta key through our [url=https://rainmaker.gg/campaign/861963-icarus-beta-weekends]Rainmaker[/url] or [url=https://woovit.info/icarus]Woovit[/url] campaigns. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/30ca1bc30db8b729c7729392e121850f06c01f48.png[/img]

[h2]Tag us in your content![/h2]

We want to see your gameplay, clips, screenshots and memes as you pump them out online. Tag us [url=https://twitter.com/surviveicarus]@surviveicarus[/url] and use our hashtag [b]#surviveicarus[/b] so we can see your work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/ded32405baf27807b9dbbd79f3cb4a1a94050a8e.png[/img]

[i][h3]It's a Beta... [/h3][/i]
New Zealand, where RocketWerkz is based, went into an unexpected covid-19 lockdown just as we were preparing for our Beta Weekends. There has been a small disruption as we move all of our developers to work from home until it is safe to return to the office. We ask for your patience should any bumps in our development arise as a result of this.

So are you counting down the days? We are! These Beta Weekends hold a crucial part in Icarus’ game development, because of you, our players and our community. We look forward to diving into each weekend with you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149460/ICARUS/

notes.title: What's in our Bi-Weekly Beta Weekends?
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE:[/b] Read the breakdown of our beta weekends [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149460/view/5664952058189839850]HERE[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/2e6c8a16ad3ced7731b93c2f3d3b0bebd04bc05e.png[/img]

[h2]Prospectors, we have an important update[/h2]

We’ve made the decision to [b]delay Icarus’ launch until November[/b] to ensure the game is the best it can be for our players, and we’re introducing a longer Beta which you can play from [b]Friday 27 August at 5pm Pacific Daylight Time.[/b]

Our team is committed to providing the best experience for our players at launch. We’ve been keeping a close eye on the state of our development builds and have decided that we want to give Icarus more love by delaying the game, and improving upon our Beta process by spreading it across multiple weekends, with each having a specific focus. A plus side of this also means reducing Beta fatigue for our players.

We acknowledge that this news may not be what you wanted to hear, but we are confident it will lead to the best possible Icarus launch!

[h3][b]All pre-orders will gain access to Beta Weekends![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/a618e5c756b7ec7236a0a120a11068b3156ecf3a.png[/img]

[u][h1]ICARUS BETA WEEKENDS ROADMAP[/h1][/u]
We’re running a series of Beta Weekends with each weekend unlocking new game features that allow us to gather more useful and focused feedback! This will provide us with more clarity on what your Prospector’s journey may look like as you progressively explore the planet.

Here’s what you can expect to unlock every Beta Weekend:

[h3]FOREST 28th - 29th August[/h3]
This will be your first weekend playing Icarus! It’s also an opportunity to begin making the YouTube and Twitch content that you’ve been eager to share with your communities. So get base building and learn to hunt, Prospector.
[list][*]Torrential Storms are [b]disabled[/b][*] Forest biome only[/list]
[h3]STORMS 11th - 12th September[/h3]
Now that you have spent time on the surface of Icarus, prepare for mother nature to do her thing. Torrential Storms are now enabled and, as seen on our Twitch streams, ensure you have your fire whacker and repair tool handy in case lightning strikes your base! Better yet, go mine some boulders to shelter in.
[list][*]Torrential Storms are now [b]enabled[/b][*] Forest biome only[/list]
[h3]ARCTIC 25th - 26th September[/h3]
Brace yourself for the cold, for you now have access to the forbidding and demanding temperatures of the Arctic biome. It's time to put your skills to the test as you prepare a survival plan for your journey.
[list][*]Arctic biome [b]unlocked[/b][*]Arctic animals and blizzards[/list]
[h3][i]*NEW*[/i] - MISSION 9th - 10th October[/h3]
You guys were so good at hunting the mammoth, we've added a special 3-part mission for Weekend Four. Get ready to seek out that downed satellite, but keep your eyes open for danger!

[h3]DESERT - 23rd - 24th October[/h3]
We don't expect you to have mastered the Arctic biome just yet - perhaps you can take a break from the frigid weather and visit the Desert for some R&R. Just kidding, there is no relaxation anywhere on Icarus.
[list][*]Desert biome [b]unlocked[/b][*]Desert animals and blizzards[/list]
[h3]FACTIONS 6th - 7th October[/h3]
What does it mean to be a Prospector? This weekend you will get your first taste of Icarus' political lore. Various factions and corporates have an interest in Icarus, but need someone expendable to run errands for them. In return for completing a series of objectives planetside they’ll reward you handsomely.
[list][*]Faction Missions [b]unlocked[/b][/list]
[h3]COMMUNITY 20th - 21st November[/h3]
Our final beta weekend will celebrate our community with a giveaway and a few other surprises. Hang tight for more information on this!
[list][*]Special Community Event[*]Prizes[/list]
We plan to accommodate multiple time zones and will confirm exact start times closer to 28 August. Anyone who pre-orders Icarus before its launch will gain access to the Beta, and pre-orders can be refunded at any time no matter how long you have played the Beta for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/fa751d18995f9b0cf1a2ad8e640f8671bf019dbd.png[/img]

[h2]Content Creators[/h2]
Are you a content creator keen to get your hands on a Beta key? Sign up through our Rainmaker campaign [url=https://rainmaker.gg/campaign/861963-icarus-beta-weekends]here![/url]

Unfortunately we can’t give keys to everyone, but if you have a loyal audience, love survival games and meet our criteria we’ll share a key with you to join the Beta Weekends.

[h2]Our Discord Community[/h2]
As mentioned in our previous announcement describing our Beta gates - select beloved Discord community members may gain access to our private "Closed Beta" under a Non Disclosure Agreement ahead of 28 August. They have been the backbone of our growth and we are indebted to their commitment and support of our team and the wider community!

[i][h3]We appreciate you![/h3][/i]
We’re really excited for your reactions, creative content and trust you appreciate the reasoning behind our launch delay. We’ll keep listening to your feedback and adapting Icarus as the Beta evolves. We encourage you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/SurviveIcarus/]Discord[/url] where we will be there to answer your queries and concerns! Most of all, to get HYPE with our community as we have officially set our Beta dates!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/fa751d18995f9b0cf1a2ad8e640f8671bf019dbd.png[/img]

[h2]Hello again, Prospectors![/h2]

Welcome back to another Community Update. It's been a great month as we continue to develop Icarus. Our private beta branch is up and running, we’ve had some guest streamers and journalists play it recently and we're busy making improvements around the clock.

We've reached over [b]5,000 members on our Discord![/b] Our server is thriving and is a wonderful place to just hang out with friends, post memes, talk about our Twitch streams and YouTube videos. So here's to the next milestone of 10,000!

She's charismatic and to the point, providing her community with "spicy" information found across our streams, YouTube development blogs and our once-in-a-while Discord leaks (thanks Dean!). [previewyoutube=-pagmGkpxXs;full]https://youtu.be/-pagmGkpxXs[/previewyoutube]
