notes.title: The Weather Systems
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/00847758ab39e7cf4ed2e49c783251615d22ea53.png[/img]

[h2]Greetings, Prospectors![/h2]

As we continue to cover many facets of Icarus’ systems and features, this week we are taking a closer look at the brooding weather that dictates your movement and strategy on the planet.

[u][h2]The core functionalities of Icarus' weather system[/h2][/u]
The weather cycles in Icarus boast both beautiful and frightening visuals across a single day. As your drop ship settles onto Icarus’ soil in the early hours of the morning, you can expect to cast your eyes on stunning clear skies and sunshine that touches the trees, lakes and mountain tops.

You are given ample time to forage for resources, craft early tier weapons and build shelter prior to your first storm encounter. There is no rhyme and reason for which storm you will experience first, meaning the more prepared you are, the better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/86b1c8d352052d0943569d4a47f4d559d962936e.png[/img]

[u][h2]The different tiers of weather[/h2][/u]
There’s no ‘one size fits all’ to Icarus' weather systems. The weather tiers in Icarus range from light showers to chaotic, torrential downpours. They are also unique to their biomes, with blizzards in the arctic and sandstorms in the desert.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/26712eecc6b15c1facd1bee6e61264831e80c9fd.jpg[/img]

Storms aren’t the only weather event that will be experienced either. Wind scales from light breezes through to wild hurricanes that will challenge even the strongest structures. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/88846aa41c5f385b5faf91675ebe0de36ab144ab.jpg[/img]

[u][h2]Impacts on  structures and the environment[/h2][/u]
Each weather tier provides a visual and audio experience and even more importantly, a game-altering experience based on its severity. One of the biggest culprits is lightning. A targeted lighting strike will set your structure ablaze, along with your character if you’re not careful when out of cover. One of the coolest features is how it interacts with the environment. A tree caught by a lightning strike will spread its fire throughout nearby trees and ground-level foliage. There’s nothing quite as terrifying as a lake of fire creeping through the bush towards you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/7c016f2dfff7d9caf35c9e98b3814da555277838.png[/img]

Buildings are also susceptible to slower but noticeable deterioration during extreme weather events. A strong enough gale will tear a roof clean off a hut if you’re not prepared to repair it on the fly. While it will provide protection for your resources and crafting benches inside, neglecting to keep your walls strong and roof reinforced will lead to your most valuable possessions being damaged. Key upgrades will show their worth as you progress through the tech trees, such as lightning rods, which can be the difference between losing a homebase and surviving to fight another day. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/570f07aad521aa12a27e062bd3a1b967b369485a.png[/img]

[u][h2]Dynamic shelter[/h2][/u]
One of the coolest features we’re excited to introduce to you is dynamic shelter. While most shelter experiences in video games is a simple ‘roof = safe’, we wanted to provide an experience that was a bit more ‘real’. Instead of using simple overlaps, or predefined safe areas, we use thousands of bounced rays to analyse your surroundings.  We process these to provide a realistic representation of how exposed your character is. This provides some unique and realistic tricks to increase your shelter, such as building against the side of cliffs, carving into rocks or even huddling with your friends. 

Exposure is a genuine danger, and while a player can attempt to push through a storm without shelter, the debuff and damage modifiers will scale quickly. The same goes for unsheltered equipment which will deteriorate and break over time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/ba5f58f173db87b19ac61458cde45bb4e8da4ca9.png[/img]

A big focus for Icarus has been the realities of weather in a survival setting. We believe a weather event shouldn’t be a visual nuisance, but a real threat to consider in your quest for exotics. By recreating these experiences, we feel confident you won’t ignore the clap of thunder in the distance, but instead will prepare for the real dangers it presents.

notes.title: The Talent Tree
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/6aa7b7fda7f73908996ff23f7212e0b91a3180e0.png[/img]

[h2]What is the Talent Tree?[/h2]

With over 250 combined talents to choose from, Icarus' Talent Tree gives you the ability to reflect your unique play-style inside three primary archetypes: Survival, Construction and Hunting.

This time around we will cover Survival and Hunting, with Construction coming in its own separate post.

[u][h2]Survival Tree[/h2][/u]
The survival tree is designed for general character survival on the planet, storm detection and weathering, resource gathering and consumption, farming, and anything to do with a character’s basic needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/898bfa7dc0f94c4be14244a95528516c766b4042.png[/img]

[u][h3]Resources[/h3][/u]
Do you like collecting materials? If so, unlocking the talents in this branch of the survival tree will make your yields more fruitful. Once you begin missions to mine exotics and return them to the orbital station you'll find a talent waiting for you called "Exotic Specialist" which marks one Exotic Deposit on your map to get you underway as fast as possible. It will save you time and maybe even your life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/d6a42091a5ada31cf6b2771ac8cfa98d648e1cfb.png[/img]

[u][h3]Exploration[/h3][/u]
If you know our Community Manager Lorii, who explores but finds herself in some sticky situations like luring bears, unlocking talents in the Exploration branch can ensure you a quick getaway!

Swimming in Icarus is necessary for cooling off when your character gets too hot, if you are on fire(?) or need a shortcut. You can also swim to escape a predator. Luckily for you there is a talent to allow you to zoom through water quickly and it might even be faster than running. Here you are also able to unlock abilities to support your team like storm detection, better shared XP gain and Field Medic that allows you to revive your friends with more health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/2489ea00243b05cdb8ea7212ebace5f44ba7c4ca.png[/img]

[u][h3]Hunting[/h3][/u]
Talents like On the Trail make you a master tracker, highlighting animal footprints to give you a advantage while hunting. There are complementary buffs for crouched shots, cheaper arrow crafting and more efficient resource gathering from prey to make you a valuable team member no matter the mission you're undertaking. And perhaps the most notable talent here, Running with the Wolves, makes you neutral to wolves so they won't bother you unless provoked with an attack.

[u][h3]Cooking / Farming[/h3][/u]
Here you'll find slower food decay, increased food buff durations, raw meat ingestion perks and talents for farming! That's right, FARMING! Ever wanted to grow your own food? In Icarus you can. This branch of the survival tree means you can work your Green Thumb to your heart's content with a handsome amount of crops to prove it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/f674eebde44b43035002c73f26e8972a2433de97.png[/img]

[u][h2]Combat Tree[/h2][/u]
This tree focuses on talents for damage-dealing weapons like bows, spears and firearms to protect and advance through to the late game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/3a9277928b09d46564c5bd8559ac8d06af888fcb.png[/img]

[u][h3]Bows[/h3][/u]
Movement speed is integral to hunting pursuits, especially as a bow wielder who sees a new target and wants to quickly move into a good spot to go for the kill shot. Here you have the chance to unlock talents that bleed your prey and/or completely immobilize them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/b731dfd6f3c2cf8557bd8dd005dd389c6ea7d4d9.png[/img]

[u][h3]Spears[/h3][/u]
Spears are reliable for multi-tasking, using them for both melee and projectile damage. When equipped with a spear, if you utilize one of the stamina regen talents, you'll find yourself catching your breath much more quickly. This is both good for your endurance when crossing multiple terrains in one stint or chasing a predator. In this branch you'll find other talents like cheaper spear crafting and throwing a spear to put out a fire (don’t ask).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/2fd67c740e79a912a536f435fd12d2d82f51a225.png[/img]

[u][h3]Blades[/h3][/u]
Everyone loves a stealth kill! Want to get the upper hand on your prey? While crouching with a knife, there is a talent here that makes you almost undetectable. Ever wanted to skin your prey instantly? If you work your way down the branch, you can. The knife is a great tool that has many uses and we trust you will execute all of them here.

[u][h3]Firearms[/h3][/u]
Nice try, Prospector! We will delve into the details of these in a separate post. Because they sure deserve one.

[i][h3]There is more to come![/h3][/i]
Your character is your identity on Icarus and as you customize your antics to suit any mission you'll feel yourself grow, improve and refine as a player.

Join our Discord server, we would love to have you! [url=https://discord.gg/surviveicarus]Discord.gg/SurviveIcarus[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149460/ICARUS/

notes.title: The Planetary Tech Tree
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/b99b88e09db8ec0c3321c9fcae75059e699ad8d7.png[/img]

[h2]What is the Planetary Tech Tree?[/h2]

When you first land on Icarus as a poor prospector you bring nothing with you. As you start gathering stones, sticks and flora with your bare hands, mine rocks using your newly crafted pickaxe, chop down trees and collect wood with your stone axe, you’ll earn experience points (XP), level up and earn points to unlock items to craft in the Planetary Tech Tree.

The items you choose will help you customize your own play style and increase your chances of staying alive longer!

The first two tiers of Icarus’ planetary tech tree have over 150 items for you to unlock and craft.

[u][h2]Tier One[/h2][/u]
Tier One provides the foundational tools to survive as a prospector. These items are fast to craft, use easily found resources and set you up with the basics to survive on Icarus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/b8342a4debe48544d29cbf0d27981078f379047c.png[/img]

[h3][u]Basic Hunting[/u][/h3]

Wolves and Bears are in abundance on Icarus’ more Earth-like terraformed areas and will approach you if you’re in their line of sight. Without the bare minimum of a Wood Spear, Wood Bow or Stone Knife, you may become a meal.

[list]
[*] [b]Stone Knife[/b]: [i]requires Fiber, Sticks and Stones.[/i]

It has baseline melee damage, skinning efficiency (how much leather you collect per skinning), yet low projectile damage when thrown from afar.

[*] [b]Bone Knife[/b]: [i]requires Wood, Leather and well... Bones.
[/i]
Slightly higher melee damage, providing more efficient skinning as well as better projectile damage compared to the Stone Knife.

[*] [b]Wood Spear[/b]: [i]requires Fiber and Sticks.[/i]

Decent melee damage with projectile damage to boot! If you're interested in getting up close and personal with your enemies, this spear is for you. You can also aim and throw from a distance while being able to retrieve it from inside your prey or from the ground.

[*] [b]Bone Spear[/b]: [i]requires Wood, Leather and Bones.[/i]

Better melee and projectile damage than a Wood Spear.

[*] [b]Wood Bow[/b]: r[i]equires Fiber and Sticks.[/i]

Sufficient but limited projectile damage. Accompanying the bow are two choices of damage-inducing arrows made from Stone orBone. If you happen to be lost or need help, you can also craft a Flare Arrow to pinpoint your position in the sky or a craft a Flame Arrow to set something alight!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/8eea185b901bad2095ad1d0c7125d1685b24a916.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/514fe64f94e9741e34ac878249bc137212cc3f9d.png[/img]

[h3][u]Basic Shelter[/u][/h3]

Building in this tier has the sole purpose of providing a shelter to survive within your immediate means.

[list]
[*] [b]Thatch:[/b] is your quick craft option.

While only requiring easily accessible materials such as Fiber and Sticks, thatch shelters give you limited durability. If you are away from your main homestead this is a good choice for a temporary hunting shed. Just remember to stay away from fire!

[*] [b]Wood:[/b] provides something a bit more rugged!

As you weather your first storms inside your cabin, you'll need a Fire Whacker to stave off flames and Repair Mallet to fix your structure's durability. Your odds of outlasting torrential wind, rain, and thunder increase drastically here but you must stay alert!
[/list]

[u][h2]Tier Two[/h2][/u]
Once you’ve hit Level 5, you will be granted access to the second tier! From here you will unlock the Crafting Bench from which every other craftable item stems from. Tier two is a little more technical, pushing you to be more strategic when gathering your resources and deciding what to spend them on. Raising the question: [b]What are you trying to achieve during this session?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/125b4425aac18acfcfea090a23a30f8853df91ad.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/bc2a93389460b68c63e9991c7fcb850df71a7b6a.png[/img]

[h3][u]Enhanced Hunting[/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]The Stone Furnace[/b]: smelts a range of elements including Iron, where you can craft deadlier weapons like the Iron Knife, Iron Spear, Crossbow and bolts. Want to hunt more efficiently? This is the way.

[*] [b]The Skinning Bench[/b]: is great for improving your Meat, Fur, Leather and Bone gathering as your "value-per-prey" efficiency is increased per carcass. Rather than skinning your kills with a knife in the field, carrying carcasses back to the bench will provide more resources.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/a61ebe9450568bab7fbeb9627e393d859edd894d.png[/img]
[i]It is important to note that you [b]need[/b] to have a complete cabin (connecting floors, walls, roof) in order to use the Crafting Bench and the other heavy duty items that require protection from the elements.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/6cf4faf5a987f013ef48a405c84260c37555c09b.png[/img]

[h3][u]Enhanced Building[/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]The Masonry Bench[/b]: gives access to Stone tier construction, making your home a far safer haven than wood could ever provide. Storms shouldn't be an issue for you now, prospector.

[*] [b]The Carpentry Bench[/b]: makes room for players to get creative with their interior design, but most importantly adds an extra layer of durability during storms. You also gain the ability to create ‘trophies’ of your favourite hunts to add some flavour to those bare walls.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/1e06da7c728c200b46acaf6bcfd9e29f931cbce5.png[/img]

[h3][u]Armor[/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]The Armor Bench:[/b] this is your first time being able to craft your own armor, congratulations! Each type has its own perks and purpose, suited for each of our biomes. Crafting Leather Armor provides a quality upgrade to protect you from early-level elemental exposure. Fur Armor is ideal for cold to freezing environments, while Ghillie Armor provides a clever advantage as you blend into the forest and shrubs around you.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/0a0aa8f1d6cbd65ede88718c4265de630f1f4b78.png[/img]

[h3][u]Consumables[/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]The Herbalism Bench[/b]: enables you to bake, cook and create sustainable food options with nutritional perks and a larger expiry window. These will alleviate the constantneed to be on the lookout for prey. Bread Dough is a must have, yet Stamina, Oxygen and Health Pastes provide boosts that can give you an edge in a tricky spot.
[/list]

[i][h3]What are your thoughts?[/h3][/i]
We've aimed to provide prospectors with a full toolkit of core survival features, with many more for you to discover. We will dive into tier three and four's more advanced machinery and materials another time.

Join our Discord server and take part in the conversation! [url=https://discord.gg/surviveicarus]Discord.gg/SurviveIcarus[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149460/ICARUS/

notes.title: Community Update #2 - To The Moon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/71fc428f540894f82b37e7a572dd0f954a5af7ec.png[/img]
[h2]GREETINGS PROSPECTORS![/h2]

It's been a jam-packed week following our announcement of [b]Icarus launching on August 11[/b]! During this time we've seen an influx of folks in our [url=https://discord.gg/surviveicarus]Discord[/url] (also looking at you, Rust community!) and a bunch of new wishlists and pre-orders.

Thank you for your support, we are in very high spirits and are eager to get our game into your hands. So now that Icarus has a launch date, what's next? In July, we begin our "staggered" beta! Yes, you read that correctly, [b]we are having a BETA![/b]

[u][h2]THE STAGGERED BETA PROCESS[/h2][/u]
[b]Gate One:[/b] [i]Under NDA, RocketWerkz developers' close friends and family get to play.[/i]
[b]Gate Two:[/b] [i]Under NDA, we invite core Discord community members to sign up via a provided Google Form.[/i]
[b]Gate Three:[/b] [i]No NDA. Open for fans who pre-ordered the Deluxe edition.[/i]
[b]Gate Four:[/b] [i]No NDA. Open for everyone who pre-ordered.[/i]
[b]Next: Launch![/b]

We don't have set dates for each step in the beta process. Rather, once we've successfully scaled up, listened to feedback and met our goals for each gate then we'll move onto the next step and gradually invite more people in. Don't worry, we'll let you know when there is an opportunity for community members and pre-order supporters to try Icarus before 11 August. 

Are you a content creator keen to get yourself a free key? Hold tight! We will launch our [url=https://rainmaker.gg]Rainmaker.gg[/url] campaign shortly.

So prepare yourselves, Prospectors! You may get your hands on Icarus sooner than you think!

[u][h2]CREATOR SPOTLIGHT[/h2][/u]
[h3]Introducing Matty Mojo![/h3]

Matty resides "down-under" and has created multiple YouTube videos on Icarus, mostly based around our live streams. One of the most unique videos that have been created around our game is one of his research pieces on Icarus' Greek lore and how it connects to our title. Talk about thinking outside of the box!

[previewyoutube=Qgn0UPDUF88;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]"I started my small channel on crafting stories in survival games, and learnt that the true test of a game in that genre is - can you craft your own story within it? I've grown to love the survival genre, I love the immersion, and love the wonder of what is over the next hill? And I love to see people try something new, and Icarus is definitely that, so on that measure alone the Icarus project deserves upmost respect. I'm confident with Dean at the helm,  with the vast experience he has in this genre he can steer Icarus to a truly exciting place. For me, the adventure is only just beginning and I look forward to etching my story into the landscape of Icarus."[/i] - Matty Mojo

Subscribe to Matty's [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCjk_OupGOTz9HkF_2Old7Ww]YouTube[/url] and follow him on [url=https://twitter.com/MojoPojos]Twitter[/url]!

[h3]That's all, folks![/h3]
Exciting times are coming, we are about to get so busy! Make sure to join our thriving Discord server Discord.gg/SurviveIcarus and follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/surviveicarus/

[i]- Lorii[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149460/ICARUS/

[h2]Mark your calendars, Icarus is releasing on August 11th![/h2]

Did we say we were launching in Fall? Well, we decided to do one better. Whether you decide to play alone or as a group of eight, you are now one day closer to surviving on Icarus!

[h2]Introducing a new game mode - OutPosts[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/7a8e3950ffbd560dc917ca57a04613a22198d97d.png[/img]

[h3]What are [i]Outposts?[/i][/h3]

Our community urged us to create a game mode that allowed them the freedom to collect resources, craft and build on Icarus without the pressure of time. So we did just that. [i]Outposts[/i] are a 1km x 1km plot of land where you can do just about everything you normally would in our original game mode but without the threat of storms and enemy AI. You can zen out, test your architecture and crafting skills, and invite your friends to come and play with you.

Currently [i]Outposts[/i] are still in development, and we cannot wait to show you what they're all about!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036764/6154c4bf469ce776d57e09fa0b8b4b76418665ea.png[/img]

[b][h3]Regarding Icarus shifting away from a free-to-play title to a premium purchase[/h3][/b]
We gave ourselves time to carefully consider the pricing model for Icarus. Our priority has always been to ensure a sustainable game of AAA quality for our players to enjoy across the years to come. Making Icarus available for purchase will allow us to confidently make regular in-game updates and develop our future DLC Chapters [i]New Frontiers[/i] and [i]Dangerous Horizons[/i] to the highest standard. 

The feedback we received from our community members in Discord aligned with our vision, and enabled us to reach this conclusion in reflecting these values. We appreciate your input tremendously!

Now.. Let the launch countdown begin!

Join our Discord community to take part in the conversation! [url=https://discord.gg/surviveicarus]Discord.gg/surviveicarus[/url]

notes.title: Community Update #1 - Blast off!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to our very first Community Update[/h1]

In the past few months, we have ramped up our community presence by hiring our Community Manager Lorii, who has nestled herself deep into our Discord and other social media to get to know everyone and spread the word!

Tangentially, we have boosted the amount of content we're releasing, including our new trailer Icarus: No Rescue, to The Making of Icarus developer vlogs and our regular Twitch streams.

We strive to be open and transparent with our game development, creating a two-way relationship. The feedback we have received on all fronts has been overwhelmingly positive and we’re set on keeping up the pace!

[u][h2]CREATOR SPOTLIGHT[/h2][/u]
What is the “Creator Spotlight”? It’s a way for us to give back and showcase our most creative community members who have taken the time to make some stellar Icarus content.

[h3]Let us introduce RoughGaming[/h3]
A US-based content creator who has uploaded a whopping seven Icarus videos to his YouTube!
With the current public information, he has covered the different crafting tiers, resources and even the process of terraforming.

“Rough” as everyone calls him, is often seen in our Discord server greeting community members, being an active chatter and contributing positively to our social spaces.

Our favourite video of his so far is [b]MONSTER OF ICARUS![/b]

[previewyoutube=JfjeKYRUrRU;full][/previewyoutube]
We reached out to Rough to find out more about why he chooses to create content around Icarus.

[i]“Icarus initially caught my attention when it was first announced because of the co-op concept. The more I learned about Icarus the more I realized that it's a combination of everything that I have always looked for in a survival game. The more I've gotten involved with the amazing community and gotten to interact with the team at Rocketwerkz, the more my passion for the project has grown. This passion has driven me to really focus a lot of my time towards making content about Icarus so I can share that passion with others. I can't wait to learn more and dive deeper into the details surrounding Icarus and eventually take on the challenges that it presents myself.” - RoughGaming[/i]

You can find Rough on these channels:
[url=https://www.twitter.com/RoughGaming_]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/c/RoughGaming/]YouTube[/url]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/roughgaming_]Twitch[/url]

[u][h2]OUR COMMUNITY IS GROWING![/h2][/u]
Though Icarus’ release date is still on the horizon, we are blown away by our flourishing community across our major platforms.

[h3][url=https://discord.gg/surviveicarus]DISCORD[/url][/h3]
We now have over 3K community members!

Our server is filled with passionate, kind and respectful survival enthusiasts who are keen to get their hands on Icarus, and they remind us of this every day ;). This is where you will find our Community Manager most active, and you’ll also find our development team joining in the conversation too. Not only do we chat about Icarus and our newly released content, but we drop secrets and discuss other video-game and non video-game topics. It’s really a community for all.

[h3][url=https://twitch.tv/surviveicarus/]TWITCH[/url][/h3]
[previewyoutube=1r2DTAFM1Cc;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
We’ve run four live broadcasts and plan to do many more. The most familiar faces you will see are Dean and Lorii, casually jamming Icarus together or conducting streams showcasing new features! You may even see one of your favourite content creators join us for a game in the future.
We see these as a prime opportunity to get truly “hands-on” with our viewers and talk about the current state of the game.

[h3][url=https://youtube.com/c/surviveicarus]YOUTUBE[/url][/h3]
[previewyoutube=U6dJsBlITxE;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
Our latest series “The Making of Icarus” follows our development team. You’ll come to know some of our development processes while also hearing how we’ve overcome some issues! These videos are aimed to provide insight into how we work as a team, and allow you to get to know us at the same time. Episode 4 is dropping this Friday 9am NZT (Thursday 2pm PT / 9pm GMT)

[b]That's all for this update![/b]
From all of us here at RocketWerkz, thanks for being an incredible community and stay safe!

[i]- Lorii[/i]

notes.title: Watch our In-Universe documentary "Icarus: No Rescue"
notes.content:
Icarus: No Rescue is told from the perspective of the earliest prospectors to come to planet Icarus after its terraforming failed, looking back twenty years later. 

Their search for exotic matter pushed them to their limits as they survived off the land in this brutal alien world. Those who missed their dropship's return to orbit were left behind forever, while others grew rich crafting exotic matter into new technologies.

[previewyoutube=aZyd1e51YMo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Icarus: No Rescue[/h1]

Filmed in a vivid documentary style with live actors, Icarus: No Rescue is told from the perspective of the earliest prospectors to come to planet Icarus after its terraforming failed, looking back twenty years later. 

Their search for exotic matter pushed them to their limits as they survived off the land in this brutal alien world. Those who missed their dropship’s return to orbit were left behind forever, while others grew rich crafting exotic matter into new technologies.

“Icarus was humanity’s greatest mistake,” explains game creator Dean Hall. “It was to be a second Earth, the first planet we terraformed and colonised in space. Unknown to us the exotic matter reacted and corrupted the planet’s terraforming, but once we realised their true value the exotics sparked an interstellar gold rush.”

Wishlist now to stay up to date with the latest in the Icarus universe, and play the game immediately on release!
